en.text: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

footnotes.text: 104:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 耶和华—我的 神啊，你为至大！ 你以尊荣威严为衣服，

zhTraditional.text: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！ 耶和華－我的上帝啊，你為至大！ 你以尊榮威嚴為衣服，

en.text: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

zhSimplified.text: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，

zhTraditional.text: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 鋪張穹蒼，如鋪幔子，

en.text: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

zhSimplified.text: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁， 用云彩为车辇， 借着风的翅膀而行，

zhTraditional.text: 在水中立樓閣的棟樑， 用雲彩為車輦， 藉着風的翅膀而行，

en.text: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

zhSimplified.text: 以风为使者， 以火焰为仆役，

zhTraditional.text: 以風為使者， 以火焰為僕役，

en.text: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

zhSimplified.text: 将地立在根基上， 使地永不动摇。

zhTraditional.text: 將地立在根基上， 使地永不動搖。

en.text: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

zhSimplified.text: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳； 诸水高过山岭。

zhTraditional.text: 你用深水遮蓋地面，猶如衣裳； 諸水高過山嶺。

en.text: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

zhSimplified.text: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃； 你的雷声一发，水便奔流。

zhTraditional.text: 你的斥責一發，水便奔逃； 你的雷聲一發，水便奔流。

en.text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

zhSimplified.text: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下， 归你为它所安定之地。

footnotes.text: - 104:8 或译：随山上翻，随谷下流

zhTraditional.text: 諸山升上，諸谷沉下， 歸你為它所安定之地。

footnotes.text: - 104:8 或譯：隨山上翻，隨谷下流

en.text: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 你定了界限，使水不能过去， 不再转回遮盖地面。

zhTraditional.text: 你定了界限，使水不能過去， 不再轉回遮蓋地面。

en.text: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷， 流在山间，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使泉源湧在山谷， 流在山間，

en.text: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

zhSimplified.text: 使野地的走兽有水喝， 野驴得解其渴。

zhTraditional.text: 使野地的走獸有水喝， 野驢得解其渴。

en.text: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

zhSimplified.text: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿， 在树枝上啼叫。

zhTraditional.text: 天上的飛鳥在水旁住宿， 在樹枝上啼叫。

en.text: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

zhSimplified.text: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭； 因他作为的功效，地就丰足。

zhTraditional.text: 他從樓閣中澆灌山嶺； 因他作為的功效，地就豐足。

en.text: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

zhSimplified.text: 他使草生长，给六畜吃， 使菜蔬发长，供给人用， 使人从地里能得食物，

zhTraditional.text: 他使草生長，給六畜吃， 使菜蔬發長，供給人用， 使人從地裏能得食物，

en.text: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

zhSimplified.text: 又得酒能悦人心， 得油能润人面， 得粮能养人心。

zhTraditional.text: 又得酒能悅人心， 得油能潤人面， 得糧能養人心。

en.text: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

zhSimplified.text: 佳美的树木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 是耶和华所栽种的，都满了汁浆。

zhTraditional.text: 佳美的樹木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏樹， 是耶和華所栽種的，都滿了汁漿。

en.text: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

zhSimplified.text: 雀鸟在其上搭窝； 至于鹤，松树是它的房屋。

zhTraditional.text: 雀鳥在其上搭窩； 至於鶴，松樹是牠的房屋。

en.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

zhSimplified.text: 高山为野山羊的住所； 岩石为沙番的藏处。

zhTraditional.text: 高山為野山羊的住所； 巖石為沙番的藏處。

en.text: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

zhSimplified.text: 你安置月亮为定节令； 日头自知沉落。

zhTraditional.text: 你安置月亮為定節令； 日頭自知沉落。

en.text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

zhSimplified.text: 你造黑暗为夜， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。

zhTraditional.text: 你造黑暗為夜， 林中的百獸就都爬出來。

en.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

zhSimplified.text: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食， 向 神寻求食物。

zhTraditional.text: 少壯獅子吼叫，要抓食， 向上帝尋求食物。

en.text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

zhSimplified.text: 日头一出，兽便躲避， 卧在洞里。

zhTraditional.text: 日頭一出，獸便躲避， 臥在洞裏。

en.text: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

zhSimplified.text: 人出去做工， 劳碌直到晚上。

zhTraditional.text: 人出去做工， 勞碌直到晚上。

en.text: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地满了你的丰富。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地滿了你的豐富。

en.text: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

zhSimplified.text: 那里有海，又大又广； 其中有无数的动物， 大小活物都有。

zhTraditional.text: 那裏有海，又大又廣； 其中有無數的動物， 大小活物都有。

en.text: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

zhSimplified.text: 那里有船行走， 有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。

zhTraditional.text: 那裏有船行走， 有你所造的鱷魚游泳在其中。

en.text: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

zhSimplified.text: 这都仰望你按时给它食物。

zhTraditional.text: 這都仰望你按時給牠食物。

en.text: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

zhSimplified.text: 你给它们，它们便拾起来； 你张手，它们饱得美食。

zhTraditional.text: 你給牠們，牠們便拾起來； 你張手，牠們飽得美食。

en.text: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

zhSimplified.text: 你掩面，它们便惊惶； 你收回它们的气，它们就死亡，归于尘土。

zhTraditional.text: 你掩面，牠們便驚惶； 你收回牠們的氣，牠們就死亡，歸於塵土。

en.text: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 你发出你的灵，它们便受造； 你使地面更换为新。

zhTraditional.text: 你發出你的靈，牠們便受造； 你使地面更換為新。

en.text: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！ 愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華的榮耀存到永遠！ 願耶和華喜悅自己所造的！

en.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

zhSimplified.text: 他看地，地便震动； 他摸山，山就冒烟。

zhTraditional.text: 他看地，地便震動； 他摸山，山就冒煙。

en.text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

zhSimplified.text: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！ 我还活的时候，要向我 神歌颂！

zhTraditional.text: 我要一生向耶和華唱詩！ 我還活的時候，要向我上帝歌頌！

en.text: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！ 我要因耶和华欢喜！

zhTraditional.text: 願他以我的默念為甘甜！ 我要因耶和華歡喜！

en.text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

footnotes.text: 104:35 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 愿罪人从世上消灭！ 愿恶人归于无有！ 我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 願罪人從世上消滅！ 願惡人歸於無有！ 我的心哪，要稱頌耶和華！ 你們要讚美耶和華！
